raw:
[
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Paris < Latin Lutetia Parisiorum; Parisii < Gaulish *pario- = 'cauldron' or 'boat' (cf. Old Irish coire); root *kwer- = 'to make'",
    "reading": "The cauldron-people: a place of boiling transformation, where raw matter is cooked into gold.",
    "languages": ["la", "cel", "gaul"],
    "source": "Xavier Delamarre, Dictionnaire de la langue gauloise (2003), s.v. *pario-",
    "confidence": 0.7
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Pa + ris; pa (Greek πα = 'all') + ris (Latin risus = 'laughter'); pa-ris = 'all-laughter'",
    "reading": "A city of universal laughter — the mask of comedy worn over tragedy's skull.",
    "languages": ["grc", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Paris ~ paris (French 'parity') ~ pair (Fr. 'pair') + is (Eng. 'is'); also 'par' (equal) + 'is' (he is)",
    "reading": "That which is equal and even — a balance point, a place of symmetry and justice.",
    "languages": ["fr", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Paris → ripa (Latin 'bank, shore'); anagram of 'ripa' = 'pair' + 's'",
    "reading": "The riverbank reversed: a city that is a threshold between water and land, a liminal shore.",
    "languages": ["la", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "P-A-R-I-S: Pater (father) + Aether (upper air) + Ratio (reason) + Ignis (fire) + Sol (sun)",
    "reading": "Father-air, reason-fire, sun — the alchemical quintessence of the philosopher's city.",
    "languages": ["la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "P (Greek rho, but Latin P = 'power') + A (alpha, beginning) + R (res, thing) + I (iota, smallest) + S (sigma, sum)",
    "reading": "Power at the beginning, the smallest thing summed — a city of microcosmic totality.",
    "languages": ["en", "grc", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.2
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "P=80, A=1, R=80, I=9, S=90 (Greek isopsephy: Pi=80, Alpha=1, Rho=100, Iota=10, Sigma=200 → 391; Latin gematria: 80+1+80+9+90=260)",
    "reading": "260 reduces to 8 (2+6+0) — the number of infinity, of the octave, of eternal return.",
    "languages": ["grc", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Paris < Old French Paris < Latin Parisii; but also homophone of 'Parisis' (coin minted in Paris); root *par- = 'to prepare' (Latin parare)",
    "reading": "The prepared place — a city as a deliberate construction, a made thing, not a found one.",
    "languages": ["la", "fr"],
    "source": "Oxford English Dictionary, s.v. 'Paris' (etymology)",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Pa (father in many tongues) + ris (rise, Eng.); pa-ris = 'father rises'",
    "reading": "The father ascends — a patriarchal phoenix, a city of resurrection and paternal law.",
    "languages": ["en", "fr"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Paris ~ paris (Turkish 'money'?) — but more directly: 'par' (equal) + 'is' (Eng. 'is') ~ 'pare' (to peel) + 'is'",
    "reading": "To pare away the skin — a city that strips illusion, revealing the core of things.",
    "languages": ["en", "fr"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Paris → 'spira' (Latin 'coil, breath'); also 'raspi' (French 'rasp')",
    "reading": "The spiral breath — a city that coils inward, a vortex of inhalation and exhalation.",
    "languages": ["la", "fr"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "P (Phoenician pe = 'mouth') + A (aleph = 'ox') + R (resh = 'head') + I (yod = 'hand') + S (shin = 'tooth')",
    "reading": "Mouth, ox, head, hand, tooth — the body's alphabet, a city as a living organism.",
    "languages": ["he", "phn"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.2
  }
]
